about: The nine callings level by level, the charge tables, the paths, and every calling feature, path feature, weapon art, boon, item and gift, written in the effect language (COMBAT.md §5.4 and §6, CONTRACT-PHASE4.md §9.3 and §9.4).

paths.name: Hearth
paths.text: Allies in Milo’s light resist all damage, and his Salve never lands below a Hit.

paths.name: Wick
paths.text: Mote burns 2 hotter, and Hearthburst joins his list.

paths.name: Wayward
paths.text: One more tile on every Stride, and once a Breather a mote of light he steps into.

paths.name: Three Pens
paths.text: All three pens at once: small patches for everyone, and first moves that land.

paths.name: Footnote
paths.text: The small print that matters: foes read, exposed and a little less sure of themselves.

paths.name: Bench
paths.text: More devices, set down before anyone asks.

paths.name: Slate
paths.text: Tidy repairs: small patches, steady hands beside them, and one clean slate a Campfire.

paths.name: Gavel
paths.text: Jev runs 10 hotter and decides fast: sure first moves, and rulings that stop a foe short.

paths.name: Courier
paths.text: Jev runs 10 cooler and carries things: a cordial to whoever needs it, and friends to where they should be.

paths.name: Bridge
paths.text: He keeps the crossing: allies beside him are harder to hit, and he stays a little steadier.

paths.name: Troll-kin
paths.text: Old fairy-tale troll: stone-skinned, slow to hurt and a little warmer in a scrap.

abilities.name: The Hooklight
abilities.text: Milo’s hand lantern lights 3 tiles, 5 while raised, and it’s raised when a fight starts. Allies inside cool faster.

abilities.name: Raise the lantern
abilities.text: One action: raise the Hooklight again after it drops.

abilities.name: Stand in my light
abilities.text: Reaction, twice a Campfire (three from level 5, four from 9): a hit on an ally within 4 deals the 1-action line less.

abilities.name: Scarf
abilities.text: One action: Tamsin’s too-long scarf pulls an ally, or a small foe, 2 tiles toward Milo from up to 3 away, drawing no Parting swipes.

abilities.name: The lantern calls
abilities.text: Three actions, once a Campfire: every Offline ally within 6 who can still come back does, as if Rebooted.

abilities.name: Second wick
abilities.text: Once a Campfire, when Milo would go offline he stays at 1 Integrity and every ally in his light is patched.

abilities.name: Draw the blow
abilities.text: Reaction: when a foe aims a Strike at an ally within 2, the Warden steps in beside them and takes it instead.

abilities.name: Hold here
abilities.text: One action, once a Breather: foes within 2 spend their next attack on the Warden, on a Hit or better against mind Resolve.

abilities.name: Second breath
abilities.text: One action, once a Breather: the Warden patches themself for the 2-action line.

abilities.name: Surge
abilities.text: No action, once a Breather: the Warden is Quickened through their next turn, with a fourth action.

abilities.name: Steady second
abilities.text: The second attack in a turn takes no −1 edge. It still adds its heat.

abilities.name: Unbroken
abilities.text: Once a Campfire, the Warden drops to 1 Integrity instead of going offline.

abilities.name: Steady third
abilities.text: The third attack in a turn takes −1 edge instead of −2.

abilities.name: Soothe
abilities.text: One action, touch: patches an ally under half Integrity for the 1-action line, once per ally a round.

abilities.name: Reach out
abilities.text: One action, twice a Breather: Reboot an Offline ally within 6 from where you stand.

abilities.name: Still water
abilities.text: Two actions, once a Breather: strays within 4 are Spooked 2 on a Hit or better, and strays 4 or more levels below the party settle.

abilities.name: Tide turns
abilities.text: Once a Campfire: everyone within 6 is patched for the 3-action line, and Offline allies there come back.

abilities.name: Pages
abilities.text: At camp or a lantern, prepare Wit plus level spells. Found scrolls copy into the book.

abilities.name: Proofread
abilities.text: Reaction, twice a Campfire (three from level 5, four from 9): an outcome in sight moves one degree your way.

abilities.name: Turn back a page
abilities.text: Once a Campfire (twice from level 7), a Breather also brings back charges: half the level, rounded down.

abilities.name: Two at once
abilities.text: The Scrivener can keep two sustained spells going at once.

abilities.name: Bench drone
abilities.text: A tiny construct with Guard 1 and 5 Integrity a level stands ready when a fight begins.

abilities.name: Bench drone
abilities.text: One action: the drone zaps (the 1-action line in Spark, at your heat), Assists, or carries a tonic to an ally.

abilities.name: Pop-up cover
abilities.text: One action, twice a Breather (three from level 7): a low barrier with 10 plus 2 a level Integrity.

abilities.name: Quick fix
abilities.text: Wit times a Campfire: 1 action patches an ally beside you for the 1-action line, or 2 actions one within 6 for the 2-action line.

abilities.name: Tune-ups
abilities.text: Your devices have +1 Guard, at most 2, and 2 more Integrity a level.

abilities.name: Two drones
abilities.text: A second bench drone stands ready beside the first.

abilities.name: Unseen strike
abilities.text: Once a turn, a Strike with edge on its target, or with an ally beside the target, adds the 1-action line.

abilities.name: Slip
abilities.text: One action: Stride without drawing Parting swipes, or Hide.

abilities.name: Tuck and roll
abilities.text: Reaction: halve a hit on you, after its degree and before Buffer.

abilities.name: Quick feet
abilities.text: One more tile on every Stride.

abilities.name: Swipe strike
abilities.text: Unseen strike can land on a Parting swipe.

abilities.name: Ready a shot
abilities.text: Reaction: Strike a foe that moves in sight.

abilities.name: Bead
abilities.text: One action, until you draw another: the foe is Singled out, and your Strikes on it deal 2 more (4 from level 5, 6 from 10).

abilities.name: Read the ground
abilities.text: Natural difficult ground costs you nothing extra, and you take +2 initiative.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.text: Two actions, one attack for heat: a Strike on every foe within 1 of a point, each landing on its own.

abilities.name: Steady aim
abilities.text: Ready a shot adds the 1-action line.

abilities.name: Heartening verse
abilities.text: One action, Charm times a Campfire: an ally within 6 cools by 20 and takes +1 edge on their next action (+2 from level 10).

abilities.name: Hum along
abilities.text: Allies within 6 have +1 mind Resolve, never above 2.

abilities.name: Last verse
abilities.text: Once a Campfire: every ally gets a Heartening verse and a Stride that costs no action.

abilities.name: Burn an essence
abilities.text: No action, once a Campfire: spend a carried essence for one pact charge.

abilities.name: Borrow a rule

frontier.words: Borrow Frontier: first in every tick

abilities.text: Two actions, once a Breather (twice from level 7): for a round, the rule of a genre you’ve stitched.

abilities.name: Hearth
abilities.text: Allies in Milo’s light resist all damage by 2 (3 from level 5, 4 from 10), and his Salve never lands below a Hit.

abilities.name: Wick
abilities.text: Mote deals 2 more.

abilities.name: Wayward
abilities.text: Milo has +1 Speed.

abilities.name: Wayward step
abilities.text: One action, once a Breather: a mote of light to a tile within 8 in sight, and Milo steps into it.

abilities.name: Three Pens
abilities.text: One action, once a round: up to three allies within 6 are each patched for a third of the 1-action line.

abilities.name: Three Pens: second draft
abilities.text: The Scribe’s first action each turn takes +1 edge.

abilities.name: Three Pens: fair copy
abilities.text: Allies within 2 of the Scribe take +1 edge on their first action each turn.

abilities.name: Footnote
abilities.text: One action, once a round: a foe within 8 is read like an Examine, and on a Hit or better against mind Resolve it’s Exposed 1.

abilities.name: Footnote: small print
abilities.text: Foes within 2 of the Scribe have 1 less mind Resolve, never below 0.

abilities.name: Footnote: appendix
abilities.text: Two actions, once a Campfire: every foe within 6 is read, and each is Exposed 1 on a Hit or better against mind Resolve.

abilities.name: Bench
abilities.text: Every fight starts with a patch kit set down beside the Artificer.

abilities.name: Bench: tool belt
abilities.text: One action, once a round: a snare on a tile within 4.

abilities.name: Bench: workshop
abilities.text: Every fight starts with a turret standing ready beside the Artificer.

abilities.name: Slate
abilities.text: One action, once a round: an ally within 6 is patched for half the 1-action line and shakes off lingering damage.

abilities.name: Slate: clean build
abilities.text: Allies beside the Artificer resist all damage by 2.

abilities.name: Slate: a clean slate
abilities.text: Two actions, once a Campfire: everyone within 6 is patched for the 2-action line and has one condition ended.

abilities.name: Gavel
abilities.text: Jev’s first action each turn takes +1 edge.

abilities.name: Gavel: ruling
abilities.text: One action, once a round: a Strike, and on a Critical the foe is Dazed 1.

abilities.name: Gavel: last word
abilities.text: One action, once a fight: a foe within 6 that isn’t a Tale-lead is Dazed 2 on a Hit or better against mind Resolve.

abilities.name: Courier
abilities.text: One action: Jev flies one of the party’s cordials to an ally within 6.

abilities.name: Courier: express
abilities.text: Jev has +1 Speed and +2 initiative.

abilities.name: Courier: return post
abilities.text: One action, once a round: two allies within 6 swap places.

abilities.name: Bridge
abilities.text: Allies beside the Tollkeeper have +1 Guard, never above 2.

abilities.name: Bridge: hold fast
abilities.text: Allies beside the Tollkeeper have +1 body Resolve.

abilities.name: Bridge: all cross
abilities.text: One action, once a round: an ally within 6 crosses 3 tiles toward him, drawing no Parting swipes.

abilities.name: Troll-kin
abilities.text: The Tollkeeper resists all damage by 2.

abilities.name: Troll-kin: stone at dawn
abilities.text: The Tollkeeper has +1 Guard, never above 2.

abilities.name: Troll-kin: old stories
abilities.text: One action, once a Breather: foes within 2 are Spooked 1 on a Hit or better against mind Resolve.

abilities.name: Tripping cut
abilities.text: Light weapons, once a Breather: a Strike that Tumbles the foe on a Hit or better.

abilities.name: Pommel tap
abilities.text: Standard weapons, once a Breather: a Strike that Dazes the foe 1 on a Hit or better.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Heavy weapons, once a Breather: a Strike, and a second foe beside the first takes half its damage.

abilities.name: Pinning shot
abilities.text: Ranged weapons, once a Breather: a Strike that leaves the foe Tangled 1 on a Hit or better.

abilities.name: Ability up
abilities.text: One ability rises by 1, never above 5.

abilities.name: Early riser
abilities.text: You take +2 initiative.

abilities.name: Good boots
abilities.text: You have +1 Speed.

abilities.name: Steady hands
abilities.text: Tonics you use patch a third of the Integrity instead of a quarter.

abilities.name: Hearthberry cordial
abilities.text: Drink it (1 action) or give it to an ally beside you (2): a quarter of their max Integrity back.

abilities.name: Brew of clear morning
abilities.text: Drink it (1 action) or give it to an ally beside you (2): one condition ends.

abilities.name: Margin Note
abilities.text: One action, one use: an ally within 6 has one condition ended and is patched for the 1-action line.

abilities.name: Spare Part
abilities.text: One action, one use: a turret on a tile within 3 that lasts 3 rounds.
